Frozen meat
Dec 2019 • Couples
We were excited to try this place, having had some excellent bbqs whilst in Vietnam we thought we would be adding this to the list how wrong we were. The meat came and was frozen and in a massive slab because of it being frozen it had no flavour and was tough. For the price you are paying I think this is unacceptable to serve frozen meat. The "sausage" is nothing more than a hotdog and pointless.
The chilli bean paste and kimchi were nice most probably from jars though sadly. A Saigon beer was 40,000 which is the dearest we have found on the island, even dearer than some of the fancy bars! 
The staff are the redeeming factor of the place they are lovely and helpful and offer excellent service.

Embarrassing experience! Terrible customer service.
Aug 2018 • Couples
We were really excited to visit this restaurant, however suffered what can only be described as humiliation as we ate. We began preparing our BBQ in exactly the same manner as every other customer. Cutting the meat with the scissors into manageable chunks, as meat was in large slabs. Customers on left and right doing exactly the same. Waitress came over and said no, let me do it. She stood over us, cooking meat and snapped at us, saying to leave it and she would do the rest. Whole restaurant able to hear. We were mortified and did nothing to deserve this embarrassment. We were the only non Asians in the restaurant and felt like we were treated differently to others. Food was nice, albeit frozen meat, but this experience was awful and embarrassing. There was no need to embarrass us in this manner... Won't be back and don't recommend.

When I first enter the restaurant, the staff was kindly greeted me like I am in Korea and I was happy with that. the staff was a girl and she handed me the menu and started asking me so many personal questions which I feel very uncomfortable. She asked " Why do you eat by yourself ? " "what do you do for work" "wow, your stomach is huge " I said to her I love to experience everything own my own since it is my personality. 

The foods are very average and very spicy. If you are looking for to come to this restaurant as a group forget it the portions are less which can only serve one person and the bill is huge. I would recommend you to go to the Ganesh Indian House it is good
